CustomField.description: Master-detail to the parent Form_Template_Page__c. Establishes the page this section belongs to and, through the page, the owning Form Template (see FormTemplateId formula). Required; deleting the page deletes its sections.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The Form Template Page this section lives on. It is set when the section is created within a page and determines where the section appears.
CustomField.label: Form Template Page
